name: react-windows-ui-workspace
description: Workspace for react-windows-ui and its Vite documentation app.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:library && pnpm run build:docs
scripts.test:consumer: pnpm run build:library && pnpm --filter @react-windows-ui/test-app typecheck && pnpm --filter @react-windows-ui/test-app build
scripts.lint: eslint src/lib/src apps/docs examples/test-app scripts src/lib/vite.config.js src/lib/scripts tests vitest.config.js eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json vitest.config.js eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json apps/docs examples/test-app src/lib/package.json src/lib/vite.config.js src/lib/scripts tests
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json vitest.config.js eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json apps/docs examples/test-app src/lib/package.json src/lib/vite.config.js src/lib/scripts tests
